summary: Iteration 9 CSS polish verified. Focus-visible accent ring works on 10+ portfolio interactive elements and 20/20 admin dashboard elements (color rgb(229,57,53), 2px solid, 2px offset). Mouse click correctly suppresses ring. Reduced-motion emulation reduces .btn-primary transition-duration from 0.3s -> 0.001s and .animate-pulse-slow from 6s -> 0.001s (also honors reveal opacity). Hover card lift preserved (translateY(-4px), 2-layer hover shadow). Admin tabs cycle without errors; reset/BADTOKEN shows 'Link not valid'. Responsive OK at 390/768/1440 (no horizontal overflow). ONE deviation from spec: resting .card-soft box-shadow renders as SINGLE layer because /app/frontend/src/lib/theme.jsx setProperty('--shadow-soft', ...) overrides the CSS var with a single-layer value (e.g. '0 8px 30px rgba(0,0,0,0.06)'), so the layered two-shadow fallback in index.css never applies at runtime.

ui_bugs.issue: Runtime computed box-shadow at rest is single layer ('rgba(0,0,0,0.06) 0px 8px 30px 0px') because theme.jsx overrides --shadow-soft with a single-layer value from shadowMap. The layered two-shadow fallback in index.css (line 313) is never used. Hover shadow IS correctly two-layer.

action_items: In /app/frontend/src/lib/theme.jsx (lines 62-67) update shadowMap values to be layered (two-shadow) so the resting depth matches the intended polish. Example: medium: '0 1px 2px rgba(0,0,0,0.03), 0 8px 30px rgba(0,0,0,0.05)'. Alternatively remove --shadow-soft from card-soft rule and hardcode the layered shadow so JS theme cannot flatten it.
critical_code_review_comments: index.css:313 uses var(--shadow-soft, layered-fallback) but --shadow-soft is always set by theme.jsx, so the layered fallback is dead code.

.input-x opts out of :focus-visible outline (index.css:242) — verify this is desired since it may hurt keyboard-only users on admin/portfolio form inputs. Currently they still get an accent glow via .input-x rules, so acceptable.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Focus-visible, reduced-motion, button:active, hover states, responsive, admin flow all verified. The only remaining issue is the layered resting card-soft shadow being flattened by theme.jsx. Once theme.jsx shadowMap is updated to layered values, re-run computed box-shadow check on '.card-soft' at rest and confirm 2+ rgba layers are present.
